scope: Existing GSU–Mugar Link south window wall, entrance and its immediate Commonwealth Avenue courtyard strip

primarySources.kind: BU published existing-condition exterior photograph, 2023 upload
supports: The Link front is a tall window wall with a complete upper glazed row, shallow lower upper-row lights, deep concrete piers and horizontal bands.
Three pairs of silver-framed entrance doors below a glazed transom zone.
Building name GEORGE SHERMAN UNION appears as pale letters on the concrete band; the previous combined GSU–Mugar plaque was not supported.
The immediate courtyard has red-brick panels divided by pale rectangular stone bands.

primarySources.section: 4.3 and 4.3.4, existing GSU–Mugar connector and exterior
primarySources.kind: Official planning document describing existing building conditions
supports: One occupied connector storey does not imply a single-storey exterior window height.
Section 4.3.4 explicitly describes the original south main entrance as a two-storey-high window wall leading into the Link.

primarySources.kind: Official BU account of Mugar entry restoration inside the Link
supports: Retain the common exterior entry and avoid inventing a new Mugar street door.

secondaryContextNotUsedAsAsBuilt.note: Existing-site photographs and an annotated aerial offer context. Proposed landscape/rendering was not treated as evidence of installed conditions.

implemented.heightStatus: Photo estimate supported by documented two-storey-high window wall, not surveyed height

courtGrid.surfaceElevation: Original source DEM + 0.155m; partitioned surfaces, no overlay and no raised platform
courtGrid.status: Pattern based on photograph, grid dimensions and phase estimated. Existing larger eastern Mugar and Redstone forecourts are not reinterpreted.

preserved: All source footprint XY coordinates, common foundation anchor and closed-building collision footprint.
Existing horizontal entrance axis, occupied floor sill, graded final approach and navigation passages.
All other Sert volumes and their heights; no new occupied upper Link floor or interior.
CDS and Questrom GLBs, campus terrain and street geometry.
omittedUncertainItems: Temporary class banners from the 2023 photograph.
Exact placement of courtyard trees, planters and low benches has not been surveyed; no new furniture was placed in pedestrian routes.
The complete GSU and Mugar facade families outside the Link remain their previous reconstructions, not fully matched to this photograph.

geometry.note: Full/mobile use the same tall window wall and pavement pattern. Mobile omits small door pull mounting blocks. Signage is runtime-only and excluded from these geometry counts.

checks: actual visible ray depths through doors, side and upper glazing
concrete belt and exact closed collider footprint/height
single brick/stone surface at unchanged DEM height
navigation corridor and shared entry reachability
validation.result: 29 focused tests passed; TypeScript build passed. Runtime visual acceptance is performed separately by the parent integration task.
